paragraphs.en: For the past few years, all of the major browser vendors (Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Mozilla, along with Igalia and Bocoup) have been working together on Interop (opens in new tab) , a project to improve universal browser support on web technologies. It’s been a remarkably successful effort; when a focus area gets added to Interop, it often winds up reaching near-100% support across all major browsers within a year. ✨
paragraphs.zh: 过去几年，所有主流浏览器厂商（Google、Apple、Microsoft 和 Mozilla，以及 Igalia 和 Bocoup）一直在共同致力于 Interop（在新标签页中打开）项目，旨在改进浏览器对 Web 技术的普遍支持。 这是一项非常成功的行动；当某个重点领域被纳入 Interop 后，往往会在一年内让所有主流浏览器对该领域的支持率接近 100%。✨

paragraphs.en: One of the most exciting ideas is the proposal to add functions to CSS (opens in new tab) :
paragraphs.zh: 其中最令人兴奋的想法之一是向 CSS（在新标签页中打开）添加函数的提议：

paragraphs.en: /* Define a function: */ @ function --gradient-to-transparent(--color, --direction: bottom) { result: linear-gradient( to var(--direction), var(--color), transparent; ); } /* Invoke it: */ . elem { background : --gradient-to-transparent( red ) ; } /* …which produces: */ . elem { background : linear-gradient ( to bottom , red , transparent ; ); } If you’re familiar with JavaScript, this should feel pretty familiar. We define new functions with @function and specify the returned value with result .
paragraphs.zh: /* 定义一个函数： */ @ function --gradient-to-transparent(--color, --direction: bottom) { result: linear-gradient( to var(--direction), var(--color), transparent; ); } /* 调用它： */ . elem { background : --gradient-to-transparent( red ) ; } /* ……其产生： */ . elem { background : linear-gradient ( to bottom , red , transparent ; ); } 如果你熟悉 JavaScript，这应该会让你感到相当熟悉。 我们使用 @function 定义新函数，并使用 result 指定返回值。

paragraphs.en: We’ve technically been able to do stuff like this with clip-path or masks, but unlike those features, corner-shape actually changes the shape of the border-box . This means that our borders, outlines, and box-shadows will correctly follow the altered corner shapes!
paragraphs.zh: 从技术上讲，我们过去可以用 clip-path 或蒙版实现类似效果，但与那些特性不同，corner-shape 会真正改变边框盒（border-box）的形状。 这意味着我们的边框、轮廓和盒阴影都会正确地跟随改变后的角部形状！

paragraphs.en: I recently published a blog post on Anchor Positioning , one of the most exciting modern CSS features (which was actually prioritized in Interop 2026, and is now widely available!).
paragraphs.zh: 我最近发布了一篇关于锚点定位的博客文章，这是最令人兴奋的现代 CSS 特性之一（它实际上已被列入 Interop 2026 的优先事项，现在已广泛可用！）。

paragraphs.en: The Anchor Positioning API allows us to anchor one element to another. For example, we might anchor a floating tooltip element to its trigger, so that no matter where that trigger is on the page, the tooltip will always be connected to it.
paragraphs.zh: 锚点定位 API 允许我们将一个元素锚定到另一个元素上。 例如，我们可以将一个浮动提示框元素锚定到它的触发器上，这样无论触发器在页面上的哪个位置，提示框都会始终连接在它上面。

sents.en: The Anchor Positioning API allows us to anchor one element to another.
sents.zh: 锚点定位 API 允许我们将一个元素锚定到另一个元素上。

sents.en: For example, we might anchor a floating tooltip element to its trigger, so that no matter where that trigger is on the page, the tooltip will always be connected to it.
sents.zh: 例如，我们可以将一个浮动提示框元素锚定到它的触发器上，这样无论触发器在页面上的哪个位置，提示框都会始终连接在它上面。

paragraphs.en: If you’ve ever tried to solve this sort of problem yourself, you know it’s surprisingly tricky. For example, we might want our tooltip to float above the anchor, but what if the anchor is near the top of the viewport?
paragraphs.zh: 如果你自己尝试过解决这类问题，你就会知道它出奇地棘手。 例如，我们可能希望工具提示浮动在锚点上方，但如果锚点靠近视口顶部怎么办？

sents.en: If you’ve ever tried to solve this sort of problem yourself, you know it’s surprisingly tricky.
sents.zh: 如果你自己尝试过解决这类问题，你就会知道它出奇地棘手。

sents.en: For example, we might want our tooltip to float above the anchor, but what if the anchor is near the top of the viewport?
sents.zh: 例如，我们可能希望工具提示浮动在锚点上方，但如果锚点靠近视口顶部怎么办？

paragraphs.en: The original Anchor Positioning API gave us most of the tools needed to solve this problem easily in CSS. It allows us to specify fallback positions; if the target element doesn’t fit above the anchor, it can flip automatically to the bottom.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的锚点定位 API 为我们提供了在 CSS 中轻松解决这一问题所需的大部分工具。 它允许我们指定回退位置；如果目标元素在锚点上方放不下，它可以自动翻转到底部。

sents.en: The original Anchor Positioning API gave us most of the tools needed to solve this problem easily in CSS.
sents.zh: 原始的锚点定位 API 为我们提供了在 CSS 中轻松解决这一问题所需的大部分工具。

sents.en: It allows us to specify fallback positions; if the target element doesn’t fit above the anchor, it can flip automatically to the bottom.
sents.zh: 它允许我们指定回退位置；如果目标元素在锚点上方放不下，它可以自动翻转到底部。

paragraphs.en: The only thing missing was the ability to tell whether or not the target had flipped. We had no way to know, in CSS, whether the target element is currently sitting above or below the anchor, whether it’s using the default or fallback position. For tooltips, this is a problem because we typically want to add a little protrusion that points towards the anchor.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一缺少的功能是判断目标元素是否已经翻转。 在 CSS 中，我们无法知道目标元素当前是位于锚点上方还是下方，也无法知道它使用的是默认位置还是回退位置。 对于工具提示（tooltip）来说，这是个问题，因为我们通常希望添加一个指向锚点的小凸起。

sents.en: The only thing missing was the ability to tell whether or not the target had flipped.
sents.zh: 唯一缺少的功能是判断目标元素是否已经翻转。

sents.en: We had no way to know, in CSS, whether the target element is currently sitting above or below the anchor, whether it’s using the default or fallback position.
sents.zh: 在 CSS 中，我们无法知道目标元素当前是位于锚点上方还是下方，也无法知道它使用的是默认位置还是回退位置。

sents.en: For tooltips, this is a problem because we typically want to add a little protrusion that points towards the anchor.
sents.zh: 对于工具提示（tooltip）来说，这是个问题，因为我们通常希望添加一个指向锚点的小凸起。

paragraphs.en: The “Level 2” version of the Anchor Positioning API includes a new type of container query that allows us to check whether the target element is using a fallback position or not. You can learn more about it in my Anchor Positioning blog post , or check out the Interop 2027 proposal (opens in new tab) .

paragraphs.en: Scroll-driven animations were part of Interop 2026 (opens in new tab) , and it’s been successfully implemented across all browsers. In addition to Scroll- driven animations, however, there’s a separate proposal for scroll- triggered animations .
paragraphs.zh: 滚动驱动动画是 Interop 2026（在新标签页中打开）的一部分，并且已在所有浏览器中成功实现。 然而，除了滚动驱动动画之外，还有一个单独的滚动触发动画提案。

sents.en: Scroll-driven animations were part of Interop 2026 (opens in new tab) , and it’s been successfully implemented across all browsers.
sents.zh: 滚动驱动动画是 Interop 2026（在新标签页中打开）的一部分，并且已在所有浏览器中成功实现。

sents.en: In addition to Scroll- driven animations, however, there’s a separate proposal for scroll- triggered animations .
sents.zh: 然而，除了滚动驱动动画之外，还有一个单独的滚动触发动画提案。

paragraphs.en: With scroll-triggered animations, the goal is to trigger a keyframe animation when the user scrolls to a specific point, like a proximity sensor going off. At that point, the animation runs normally over a specified duration.
paragraphs.zh: 使用滚动触发动画时，目标是当用户滚动到某个特定位置时触发一个关键帧动画，就像接近传感器被触发一样。 到了那个位置，动画就会在指定的时长内正常运行。

paragraphs.en: We can currently implement scroll-triggered animations using the IntersectionObserver API in JavaScript, but it’s kind of a pain. It’ll be super nice when we can use CSS for both scroll-driven and scroll-triggered animations, since they each have their own use cases.
paragraphs.zh: 目前我们可以使用 JavaScript 中的 IntersectionObserver API 来实现滚动触发动画，但这有点麻烦。 当我们能够用 CSS 同时实现滚动驱动动画和滚动触发动画时，将会非常方便，因为它们各自有其适用的场景。

paragraphs.en: This is one of the great things about responsive CSS, but it leads to an unfortunate side effect: tab order is always based on the DOM order, not the visual order. So, if someone uses assistive technologies to navigate between elements, that navigation order will always be the same, even as the layout changes dramatically depending on screen size.
paragraphs.zh: 这是响应式 CSS 的优点之一，但它也带来了一个不幸的副作用：Tab 键的顺序始终基于 DOM 顺序，而不是视觉顺序。 因此，如果有人使用辅助技术在元素之间进行导航，其导航顺序将始终相同，即使布局会随着屏幕尺寸的变化而发生巨大改变。

paragraphs.en: Thankfully, the new reading-flow property grants us a solution to this problem, and there’s a proposal for Interop 2027 (opens in new tab) .
paragraphs.zh: 幸运的是，新的 reading-flow 属性为我们提供了解决这一问题的方案，并且已有针对 Interop 2027 的提案（在新标签页中打开）。

paragraphs.en: The basic idea is that we can specify that the tab order should follow one of several visual orders:
paragraphs.zh: 基本思路是，我们可以指定制表符顺序遵循几种视觉顺序之一：

paragraphs.en: . grid { display : grid ; reading-flow : grid-rows ; } There are values for both CSS Grid and Flexbox, and if you need even more control, the reading-order property allows us to create a custom order, sorta like tabIndex in HTML.
paragraphs.zh: . grid { display : grid ; reading-flow : grid-rows ; } CSS Grid 和 Flexbox 都有对应的值，如果你需要更多控制，reading-order 属性允许我们创建自定义顺序，有点类似于 HTML 中的 tabIndex。

paragraphs.en: This property has been championed by one of my personal heroes, Rachel Andrew. You can read more about it in her blog post on reading-flow .
paragraphs.zh: 这一特性得到了我个人的偶像之一 Rachel Andrew 的大力倡导。 你可以在她关于 reading-flow 的博客文章中了解更多相关内容。

paragraphs.en: A long-standing pain point on the web has been the inability to animate between keyword values like auto . The interpolate-size property solves this problem, and there’s an Interop 2027 proposal (opens in new tab) for it, alongside the related calc-size() function.
paragraphs.zh: 长期以来，Web 上的一个痛点是无法在 auto 等关键字值之间进行动画过渡。 interpolate-size 属性解决了这个问题，并且与相关的 calc-size() 函数一起，已有针对它的 Interop 2027 提案（在新标签页中打开）。

sents.en: A long-standing pain point on the web has been the inability to animate between keyword values like auto .
sents.zh: 长期以来，Web 上的一个痛点是无法在 auto 等关键字值之间进行动画过渡。

sents.en: The interpolate-size property solves this problem, and there’s an Interop 2027 proposal (opens in new tab) for it, alongside the related calc-size() function.
sents.zh: interpolate-size 属性解决了这个问题，并且与相关的 calc-size() 函数一起，已有针对它的 Interop 2027 提案（在新标签页中打开）。

paragraphs.en: The most common use case for this feature is to animate between height: 0 and height: auto , for creating collapsible accordion-type UIs:
paragraphs.zh: 此功能最常见的用例是在 height: 0 和 height: auto 之间进行动画过渡，以创建可折叠的手风琴式 UI：

paragraphs.en:
< style > html { interpolate-size : allow-keywords ; } @supports ( interpolate-size : allow-keywords ) { details { overflow : hidden ; & ::details-content { height : 0 ; transition : height 300 ms , content-visibility 300 ms ; transition-behavior : allow-discrete ; } & :open ::details-content { height : auto ; } } } < details > < summary > Click me to show/hide! < p > This is the hidden content which animates as it is shown/hidden. 😄

paragraphs.en: One of the things that makes CSS Grid layout unique is that the grid children are positioned using rows/columns defined entirely in CSS. In every other layout mode, elements are positioned using other elements! In Table layout, for example, every grid cell has an associated <td> or <th> element.
paragraphs.zh: CSS Grid 布局独特之处之一是，网格子元素完全使用在 CSS 中定义的行/列来定位。 在其他所有布局模式中，元素都是使用其他元素来定位的！ 例如，在表格布局中，每个网格单元都有一个关联的 <td> 或 <th> 元素。

sents.en: One of the things that makes CSS Grid layout unique is that the grid children are positioned using rows/columns defined entirely in CSS.
sents.zh: CSS Grid 布局独特之处之一是，网格子元素完全使用在 CSS 中定义的行/列来定位。

sents.en: In every other layout mode, elements are positioned using other elements!
sents.zh: 在其他所有布局模式中，元素都是使用其他元素来定位的！

sents.en: In Table layout, for example, every grid cell has an associated <td> or <th> element.
sents.zh: 例如，在表格布局中，每个网格单元都有一个关联的 <td> 或 <th> 元素。

paragraphs.en: There are a lot of upsides to CSS Grid, but one of the downsides is that it’s not as easy to add borders between grid cells. If a grid cell is empty, there’s no element to slap a border: 1px solid on!
paragraphs.zh: CSS Grid 有很多优点，但缺点之一是在网格单元之间添加边框并不容易。 如果某个网格单元是空的，就没有元素可以应用 border: 1px solid 样式了！

paragraphs.en: The gap decorations proposal (opens in new tab) introduces a new set of CSS properties that will allow us to use a border-like syntax on the grid itself. Check this out:

paragraphs.en: The basic idea is that the grid itself gets a background-color that matches the border we want, and we add a 1px gap so that the background peeks through between each cell.
paragraphs.zh: 基本思路是：让网格本身拥有一个与我们想要的边框颜色相同的背景色，然后添加 1px 的间距，让背景色在每个单元格之间显露出来。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, this means that we need to add a bunch of empty DOM nodes to fill each cell in the grid. It also only works if the page background is a solid color. And it’s nowhere near as flexible as the upcoming rule property is; for example, we can’t add a bit of space between the grid’s outer border and the inner grid lines.
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，这意味着我们需要添加大量空的 DOM 节点来填充网格中的每个单元格。 它只在页面背景为纯色时才能生效。 而且它远不如即将推出的 rule 属性灵活；例如，我们无法在网格的外边框与内部网格线之间添加一点间距。

paragraphs.en: I know it’s kind of a weird time right now for web developers, and many of us are wondering whether we even need to care about this kind of stuff anymore. If we’re delegating all of our work to LLMs, do we still need to keep up with the latest-and-greatest CSS features?
paragraphs.zh: 我知道现在对 Web 开发者来说是一个有点奇怪的时候，我们中的许多人都在怀疑我们是否还需要关注这类东西。 如果我们把所有工作都委托给大语言模型，我们还需要跟进最新最棒的 CSS 特性吗？

sents.en: If we’re delegating all of our work to LLMs, do we still need to keep up with the latest-and-greatest CSS features?
sents.zh: 如果我们把所有工作都委托给大语言模型，我们还需要跟进最新最棒的 CSS 特性吗？

paragraphs.en: Personally, I think it’s more important than ever. We can’t expect LLMs to use modern CSS features when so much of their training data is years old. Most of the features I’ve shared in this post can be used today as a progressive enhancement, and if history is any guide, many of them will soon be widely available.
paragraphs.zh: 就我个人而言，我认为它比以往任何时候都更重要。 当如此多的训练数据已经是几年前的内容时，我们不能指望大语言模型（LLMs）去使用现代 CSS 特性。 我在这篇文章中分享的大多数特性今天都可以作为渐进增强来使用，而且如果历史有什么指导意义的话，其中许多特性很快就会得到广泛支持。
